notes: FID April 2025 (JV holding CF Industries 40%, JERA 35%, Mitsui 25%); operations expected 2029; CO2 to the Pelican Sequestration Hub; ATR technology licensor not named in the report. GCCSI's November 2024 Global Status report lists this as 'CF Industries Blue Point' at the 'Under Evaluation' stage, 1.2 Mt/yr ammonia with a 2030 target — a pre-FID snapshot that predates the April 2025 FID recorded in this project.
